create_matcher: create a Matcher instance with allow_low_quality_matches set to True or False
call_matcher_with_iou: call the Matcher on a match_quality_matrix tensor with a custom IoU threshold
match_predictions_to_ground_truth: match predicted elements to ground-truth elements using an MxN quality matrix and IoU threshold
set_low_quality_matches: set low quality matches for unmatched predictions by finding highest quality ground-truth pairs
review_matcher_class: review the Matcher class and its BELOW_LOW_THRESHOLD and BETWEEN_THRESHOLDS constants
